template_purpose: Populate only after the Star currentness evidence record has been built from a fresh official-source observation. This template is intentionally non-executable until human review selects the temporal outcome and removes all __CAPTURE_REQUIRED__ sentinels.

decision_rules.current_observed_reviewed: Requires a byte_identical_observed source observation, a built/validated document_currentness_evidence_record_v1, and human review establishing that the live official source associates this wording with the current Star Comprehensive product/UIN. Hash equality alone is not sufficient.
decision_rules.replaced: Use when fresh official-source evidence shows the registered wording is superseded or a different wording is the applicable current document; do not mutate the historical registered version.
decision_rules.compatibility_unverified: Use when the observation succeeds but the live source does not establish a sufficiently strong current product/UIN-to-wording association. Omit currentness_evidence_path for this outcome.
decision_rules.observation_failed: Use only when the source observation record itself has byte_comparison.status=observation_failed. Omit currentness_evidence_path for this outcome.
